newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toray to make industrial-use polyester in Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Toray to make industrial-use polyester in Thailand.

text.p: Toray Industries Inc said on Wednesday that it has decided to start integrated operations to produce industrial polyester products in Thailand.

Toray will produce polyester filament and other polyester products for industrial use at three Toray units in Thailand, Toray Nylon Thai Co Ltd, Luckytex (Thailand) Public Co Ltd, and Thai Toray Textile Mills Public Co Ltd.
Operations are expected to start in April 1998, Toray said.
The three companies currently produce polyester products for non-industrial use such as for clothing, Toray said.
Investment in new facilities for industrial-use polyester is estimated at about four billion yen, Toray said.
